verdict.rationale: The Priority Processing docs describe latency in streaming terms: they promise lower time-to-first-token and faster inter-token latency, which implies token-by-token output and documents at least one latency lever. Explicit text streaming documentation, such as stream parameters or SSE event formats, is not in the pack. The only explicit streaming evidence is real-time WebSocket audio transcription. Missing for 10: explicit text-streaming API docs, published latency/TTFT figures or SLAs, evidence of sub-second responses, and independent hands-on corroboration of streaming latency.
